verdicts.reason: Both cram every element of the poster into a 728x90 strip. The italic subtitle becomes an unreadable 5–7 line sliver, the legal text is tiny, the CTA pill is no bigger than the badges, and the product can is a speck. A splits the headline onto two lines but keeps the Solstice sun logo visible and the legal block apart from the placeholder. B's one-line headline is stronger, but its logo is nearly gone, its subtitle is a 7-line column jammed against 'Saturday 21 June', and its legal text collides with the red missing-asset placeholder.
